title: PostRecord
description: One current belief about one Truth Social status (docs/SPEC.md section 2). This file is the single source of truth for the record shape: check_data validates against it, build_db derives columns from it, and the SPEC table is generated from it.

tsId.description: Truth Social status id; Snowflake-like, increasing with time; sort numerically.

created_at_utc.x-provenance: created_at_rank: api > cnn > trumpstruth; 2 s tolerance
created_at_utc.description: For a reblog: when Trump reposted.

content_html.x-provenance: content precedence; for a reblog the reblogged post's html
content_html.description: Empty string when unknown or empty.

content_text.x-provenance: recomputed from content_html; cnn text when html is empty

reblog_of_acct.x-provenance: scalar precedence; a cnn-sourced value is a guess when content_text starts with a word character (cnn_ambiguous_handles)

media.x-provenance: list precedence plus positional fill of null mirror/preview/size fields

card_domain.description: Hostname of card_url without a leading www.

status.x-provenance: present -> deleted on any deletion signal; deleted -> present only on an api live sighting (anomaly resurrected)

deleted_lower.x-provenance: max over signals of (last_verified_live_at else created_at_utc); never trumpstruth_captured_at
deleted_lower.description: Last moment the post was known to exist.

deleted_upper.x-provenance: min over signals of (trumpstruth_removed_at | api404 observed_at)
deleted_upper.description: First moment the post was confirmed gone.

deleted_source.x-provenance: the signal that first set deleted; never changes

trumpstruth_captured_at.x-provenance: trumpstruth, latest wins; NOT evidence of life (removed pages are re-processed)

field_sources.description: field name -> source that last set it. Keys must be record field names.

raw_api.x-provenance: latest api object with every account key removed

updated_at.x-provenance: set only when the record changed

updated_run_id.x-provenance: set only when the record changed

x-invariants: created_at_utc <= deleted_upper when both set (hard: created_after_deleted_upper)
deleted_lower <= deleted_upper when both set (soft: inverted_deletion_bounds)
status == 'deleted' implies deleted_source is not null
field_sources keys are a subset of the property names of this schema
record lives in posts/<month_of(created_at_utc)>.jsonl and files are sorted by int(ts_id) (hard: wrong_month_file, unsorted_file)

x-roles.content: what the post said and linked; subject to source precedence
x-roles.derived: recomputed from other fields, never authoritative
x-roles.sighting: when and by whom we first and ever saw it
x-roles.existence: whether it still exists and the interval in which it stopped
x-roles.source-meta: one source's own bookkeeping about the post
x-roles.provenance: why each value is what it is
